publishedDescription: Officially released in a journal or book after peer review.

earlyAccessDescription: Available online before print publication, often after peer review.

biologicalProfileDescription: Data describing the biological characteristics of the studied individuals, including sex and age-at-death.
measurementsDescription: Osteometric measurements collected from human skeletal remains.
nonMetricTraitsDescription: Skeletal and dental morphological variants used to assess biological relationships, population affinity and individual variation.
paleopathologyDescription: Evidence of disease, trauma, and other pathological changes observed on human skeletal remains.
paleodemographyDescription: Information on the demographic structure of past populations, including age-at-death distribution, sex composition and mortality patterns.
stableIsotopesDescription: Stable isotope analyses (e.g. carbon, nitrogen, oxygen or strontium) used to investigate diet and mobility, and related aspects of past human lifeways.
ancientDnaDescription: Ancient DNA analyses used to investigate ancestry, kinship, population structure, and population history.
